QuestInfo.name: [Icy Onslaught - Daily] Inverno, King of Fiends
QuestInfo.0: Kidan has something to tell you. Go and find out what it is.
QuestInfo.1:
Kidan tells you the Alliance has located the lair of Inverno, the king of the Frost Fiends...
#bDefeat Inverno the king of the Frost Fiends#k, scourge of Maple World!
#r[Finding Inferno]#k
1) Accept the quest '#b[Icy Onslaught - Boss Battle] The King of Frost#k' from the event notifier
2) Move to the Frost Fiends camp
Note that some areas will not allow you to teleport.
QuestInfo.2: Kidan told you the Alliance has located the lair of Inverno, the king of the Frost Fiends.\r\nYou defeated Inverno, but Kidan is worried that the fiend may return. You should stop by again tomorrow just in case.

default.0: Have you really defeated Inverno the Frost King?
